about.historyIntro: Sushi Umami is more than a restaurant: it's an invitation to a journey at the heart of Japanese cuisine, in a single meal. All-you-can-eat, our buffet brings together the best of Japanese gastronomy — sushi and sashimi prepared fresh, creative makis, yakitori, tempura, wok noodles and homemade desserts — in an elegant setting with clean lines and golden touches, designed to offer a refined yet welcoming experience.
about.historyText3: The restaurant stands out with its seven themed worlds, each designed to awaken the senses and multiply discoveries. Sushi, makis, yakitori, tempura or homemade desserts: everyone can choose their own journey, all you can eat.
about.historyText4: A unique experience to live… and relive.
about.philosophyText1: At Sushi Umami, every meal is an adventure at the heart of Japan. Our generous buffets let you discover the best of Japanese cuisine: sushi, sashimi, makis, yakitori, tempura, wok noodles and homemade desserts. There's something for every taste… and every craving.
about.philosophyText3: But beyond the plate, we want to nourish the senses: immersive decor, a warm atmosphere and attentive service enhance every meal.
about.teamText1: Behind every dish is a passionate, united and multicultural team, driven by service excellence and respect for culinary traditions.
about.teamText2: Our chefs embody the richness of our menu, each bringing their personal touch to elevate world recipes with authenticity and creativity.
about.teamCohesion: Team cohesion: a family atmosphere that can be felt in the warmth of the welcome.
about.qualityCommitment: Quality & freshness: carefully selected products, renewed every day to guarantee you the best.
about.environment: Environmental respect: we fight against food waste and integrate sustainable practices into our daily operations.

privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how your personal data is collected and processed when you browse this website and interact with the restaurant, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.controllerText: The data controller is {{company}}, whose registered office is located at {{headOffice}}. For any question regarding your data, you may contact us by phone at {{phone}} or by post at the registered office address.
privacy.dataText: This is a showcase website and does not include any data collection form. Personal data (name, phone number, date and number of guests) is collected only when you make a booking through our online reservation tool or when you contact us by phone.
privacy.purposeText: The data collected is used solely to manage your bookings, respond to your requests and organise service within the restaurant. It is never sold on or used for unsolicited marketing.
privacy.reservationText: Reservations are handled through a third-party service accessible from the “Book” buttons on the site (reservation.ody.app). The information you enter there is processed by this provider on behalf of the restaurant, solely to handle your booking request.
privacy.cookiesText: This site does not use advertising cookies or marketing tracking. Only technical elements strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the site may be used.
privacy.retentionText: Your data is kept only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected (managing the booking and customer relationship), then deleted or archived in accordance with applicable legal obligations.
privacy.rightsText: In accordance with the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your personal data.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us by phone at {{phone}} or by post at {{headOffice}}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.updateText: This privacy policy may be amended at any time to reflect legal developments or changes in our practices. We encourage you to review it regularly.
